decisions.reason: All hard gates pass and the mask review shows coherent localized moderate tumor-boundary growth. Candidate 01 has the strongest local population score and best overall preservation of source spacing and clustering among the alternatives.
decisions.tissue_geometry: Both edited regions extend from existing tumor-stroma interfaces without creating isolated tumor islands or disturbing neighboring auxiliary structures; tissue geometry is shared by the three passing candidates.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Forty class-1 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Candidate 01 has source-relative NND 0.981, Ripley K24 0.915 and p95 instance-area 0.990.
decisions.coupling: Nuclear additions follow the authorized expanded tumor regions, with full anchor coverage and passing external-boundary and seam-continuity checks.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and native structures outside support remain preserved, with no partial-instance, overlap or containment failure.
decisions.limitations: This is mask-only evidence under an uncalibrated research envelope, not generated-H&E assessment or clinical validation.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff.
